body.x: Daegu Techno Park Sports & Multimedia Industry Support Center supported 3 companies including 'Snowmons', '202 BPM', 'Se Young Information Communication', etc. at 'CES 2017' that will be held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th.

Daegu Techno Park Sports Complex Industrial Support Center is an organization that fosters local economy and fosters local sports industry by creating synergy through fusion of local main and strategic industries and sports industry. The major projects include the establishment of a sports industry cluster / revitalization of the sports industry promotion / diffusion of the sports industry / the securing of professional competence and the combined R & D of regional specialization. The support for the CES is supported by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and Daegu Metropolitan City. As a part of the "Cultivating the Sports Complex Industry Base".

BUFF-UP, introduced by 202 BPM, is a product that can combine balance exercise and body weight training. It can check schedule, coaching training, and athletic performance through smartphone interlocking. SKIATE, introduced by another company Snowmons, is a product that combines skiing and snowboarding, so even beginners can easily learn. Se young Information and Communications Co., Ltd unveiled a two-way wireless transceiver station WiWi.

Lee Jae-hoon, center director of the Daegu Sports Complex Industry Support Center, said, "Since the issue of CES was 'connectivity,' buyers showed a lot of interest in healthcare and sports products that combine sports and ICT technology” and evaluated the possibility of overseas expansion of foreign companies positively.

On the other hand, Daegu Techno Park, Kyungpook National University Smart Venture Business School, Kyungpook National University Smart Drone Technology Center opened 'CES Daegu Joint Pavilion' and supported the exhibition management and business buyer consultation of 22 companies in Korea.

CES, the world's largest IT appliance exhibition, is an annual showcase of the global consumer electronics industry and is held annually in January by the American Consumer Electronics Association (CTA).

Having reported the most recent issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the last decade, AVING NEWS is sending out a special report team to CES this year to report major market issues and introduce Korean companies to the world.
